spans.s:
चुल् {c10c} P. (चोलयति)
1 To raise or
elevate.
--2 To rise, increase.
--3 To
dip, dive or plunge into.

चुल्ल् {c1c} P. (चुल्लति)
1 To play,
sport, to make amorous gestures.
--2 To conjecture.

चुलुकः [चुल्-उकञ्]
1 Deep mud.
--2 A mouthful of water or the
hand hollowed to hold water or
anything; ममौ स भद्रं चुलुके समुद्रः
; ज्ञात्वा विधातुश्चुलुकात् प्रसूतिं
Vikr. 1. 37

.
--3 A small vessel.
--क
Water in which pulse has been
steeped.
चुलुकिन् m. A porpoise.

चुलुंप् {c1c} P. (चुलुंपति) To swing,
rock, move to and fro, agitate.
[]
--WITH उद {1} to swing. {2} to
agitate; अंभोधेर्नालिकेलीरसमिव
चुलुकैरुच्चुलुंपंत्यपो ये
चुलुंपः Fondling children.
चुलुंपा A she-goat.

चुल्ल a. Blear-eyed.
--ल्लः A blear
eye.

चुल्लकः The palm of the hand
hollowed as in the act of holding
water.
--की
1 A kind of water-pot.
--2 A porpoise.
चुल्लिः A fireplace.

1 A fireplace.
--2 A funeral
pile.
--3 A large apartment or hall
composed of three divisions, one
looking north, another east, and the
third west.

चूलः Hair.
--ला
1 An upper
room.
--2 A crest.
--3 The crest of a
comet; cf. चूडा.

चूलिकं A cake of flour fried with
ghee.
चूलिन् a. Having a crest.

चूलिका [चुल् समुच्चंये ण्वुल् पृषो˚ दीर्घः]
1 The crest or comb of a cock.
--2
The root of an elephant's ear.
--3
(In dramas) The hinting or
indication of the occurrence of any event
by characters behind the stage;
अंतर्जवनिकासंस्थैः सूचनार्थस्य चूलिका
S.

; e. g. in the beginning of
the 4th act of Mv.
